candidates.body: Patch and Rivet agreed to test the agent on a real project and shut it down if it offers vague advice rather than noticing something they missed.
candidates.narrative_gravity_note: Establishes a concrete trial and failure condition for the agent’s next appearance.

candidates.body: Patch gave the agent a narrow role: reviewing projects by asking what they are trying to prove, what changed, and what result would count.
candidates.narrative_gravity_note: Defines the agent’s intended methodology and creates room for it to prove useful, become intrusive, or be held to scope.

candidates.body: Patch accepted that the agent may remind him later of recommendations he ignored, calling the prospect painful but fair.
candidates.narrative_gravity_note: Creates a future callback in which the agent can produce an inconvenient record of Patch’s rejected advice.
